scope: The pasted inventory was available; the referenced full scratchpad audit reports were not present in this checkout. Source triage alone is not exploit validation. Proposed fixes are not merged.
validation_limits: Windows toolchain has CGO_ENABLED=0 and no C compiler; local race-detector execution is unavailable. Required Linux CI runs race tests.
Workflow scripts are tested with mocked GitHub commands; no release was published and no live ruleset was changed.
J-02 is only partially mitigated; incomplete UTF-8 prefixes and marker fallback need aggregate work limits.

findings.title: Glob CPU cap applies to each authorization check, and DeleteObjects runs up to 1000 checks per request
findings.validation: TestRequestBudgetAcrossDecisions; TestDeleteObjectsSharesAuthorizationBudget

findings.title: Sync after a forced promote or failover still loses locks (metadata overwrite; sibling replicas)
findings.validation: TestDivergedSyncPreservesStrongerMetadataLock; TestForcedPromotionMarksSiblingCopiesDiverged

findings.title: Purging a deleted bucket's Diverged copy imports its locked versions into a re-created bucket of the same name
findings.validation: TestPurgeDoesNotImportIntoRecreatedBucket

findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 prefix or marker makes a native listing page through the whole remote bucket
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Reproduced impossible-byte prefixes making remote LIST calls. Those now return immediately and walks stop past their prefix range. Incomplete UTF-8 byte prefixes and loose marker lower bounds retain compatibility; aggregate page-work limits remain unresolved. Do not close this finding.

findings.title: PutObject with a dummy ?versionId skips s3:ExistingObjectTag conditions
findings.validation: TestDummyVersionCannotHideExistingTags

findings.title: x-gos3-* CreateBucket headers can be added unsigned to presigned or replayed requests
findings.validation: TestGos3HeadersMustBeSigned

findings.title: Native bucket record outlives its deleted remote bucket; the name can be taken on a global namespace
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Native detach deletes the remote before dropBucket removes its local record. Crash/restart and globally reused-name attack still need reproduction.

findings.title: Overlay records whose delete failed are never retried; ACLs come back after a restart
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: dropBucketOverlays erases memory before DeleteRecords; a retry sees nothing to delete. Persistence failure/restart test is still needed.

findings.title: UploadPartCopy re-authorizes the source against a stale cached snapshot
findings.validation: TestMultipartCopyRefreshesSourcePermissions

findings.title: Prefix-scoped policy rewrite keeps wildcard-bucket Allow ARNs
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: rewriteScoped preserves resource ARNs outside the literal source-bucket prefix; wildcard-bucket policies need a permission-subset regression.

findings.title: Diverged restore undoes a legitimate delete made on the new primary
findings.validation: TestDivergedCopyDoesNotUndoAuthorizedDelete

findings.title: errLockedConflict is swallowed; the member is marked Synced and Diverged is cleared
findings.validation: TestLockedConflictNeverMarksMemberSynced

findings.title: Resuming a failed job skips the cycle and one-writer checks
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: activeJobs excludes finished jobs; inspect resumption admission and concurrent submission under the same reservation before closing.

findings.title: Copier and replication load every version of a key into memory
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: zipwalk bounds a batch only when a new key starts, and KeyVersions collects every version of a key. Source supports unbounded per-key memory.

findings.title: A vouched address takes over a verified discovery peer and pushes out its real address
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: observeVerified accepts a new address for a verified ID when vouchedLocked succeeds. Address eviction/takeover needs a full discovery test.

findings.title: Null-version operations on a remote that omits the version header hit the latest version
findings.validation: TestMissingVersionHeaderKeepsNullTarget

findings.title: Lease holder keeps serving reads for about one interval after the lease can be taken
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Lease expiry is checked after a bounded renewal attempt. Read fencing during the renewal interval needs a fake-clock/reachability regression.

findings.title: Retention and prune can delete a snapshot while it is being restored
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Retention forgets snapshot IDs without a shared active-restore reservation in the inspected path. Concurrent restore/prune test still needed.

findings.title: First-come global mDNS and verify caps let one host hide real servers
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: mDNS records share a first-come global cap. Per-sender fairness and verified-server starvation need workload tests.

findings.title: restic --server prints raw JSON error text, allowing terminal escape injection
findings.validation: TestResticAPIErrorCannotInjectTerminalEscapes

findings.title: CSP script-src 'self' allows same-origin objects as scripts
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: CSP script-src permits self. Exploitation additionally needs a same-origin executable object and an injection/import path; not independently demonstrated.

findings.title: Restic restores unbounded (1-byte range forces a full restore, no cap)
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Restic Reader.prepare restores the full object before satisfying a read. Resource/concurrency bounds require a separate design and workload test.

findings.title: Case-variant tag keys defeat negated tag Deny conditions
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Tag ingestion preserves case-distinct keys and IAM merges their values. Negated tag conditions need a regression plus an explicit compatibility decision.

findings.title: Failed force delete strips PAB, ownership, policy and lock config
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Force deletion empties configuration before final DeleteBucket. Failure injection must establish which guards survive every failure path.

findings.title: Restic password is the raw master key
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: PasswordFromKey is the raw master key hex encoding. Confirmed key reuse; changing it requires repository password migration, not a silent derivation change.

findings.title: Import replaces a same-ID version with no atomic lock check
findings.validation: TestImportCannotReplaceLockedVersion; conformance Optional/VersionImporter/LockedReplacement

findings.title: Slow PutObject holds the bucket write gate
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: NewObjectWriter enters the bucket gate before streaming. A slow writer can delay quiescence; bounded test and publication-only gate design remain.

findings.title: s3-backing journal not authenticated; data key bound only to data ID
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Journal records use an unkeyed SHA-256 checksum. Authentication and identity binding require a versioned format and tamper/recovery tests.

findings.title: Discovery re-probe stall expires live peers
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Maintenance waits for bounded-concurrency probes; late refreshes versus expiry need fake-clock and stalled-probe tests.

findings.title: arn:gos3:admin:::** misses service-level actions
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Parser accepts all-star admin ARN suffixes, while service matching special-cases the single-star ARN. Add Allow and Deny service-action regressions.

findings.title: HEAD/GET leak lock state and tag count
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: GET/HEAD headers include tag counts and lock metadata. Permission filtering and S3 compatibility need separate verification.

findings.title: POST policy x-amz-date not clock-checked
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: POST authentication checks date syntax, scope date, signature and policy expiration, without normal header-auth clock skew checking. Whether this is a vulnerability needs POST-policy compatibility validation.

findings.title: Copy-job remoteBucket not validated
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Creation options pass RemoteBucket into BucketTarget. Validate the full call chain and reject invalid names before probing a remote.

findings.title: Jobs bind buckets by name
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Job refresh checks bucket existence by name. Immutable incarnation binding is still required; delete/recreate regression pending.

findings.title: New replica reuses and wipes an unrelated same-name bucket
findings.validation: TestReplicaRefusesUnrelatedSameNameBucket

findings.title: Ranged GET does not verify 206/Content-Range
findings.validation: TestGetObjectValidatesRemoteRange

findings.title: On-link host fills the discovery probe queue
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Discovery candidates feed a shared verification queue after per-address throttling. Sender fairness and starvation need a load test.

findings.title: Beacon bye spoofable and not rate-limited
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Beacon bye dispatch lacks the announce/query rate limiter in the inspected switch. Spoofed withdrawal needs a peer-state regression.

findings.title: Beacon accepts off-link spoofed datagrams
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: The inspected handler already rejects off-link source addresses. A spoofing claim requires the original packet-level evidence and receive-interface/TTL analysis; not confirmed by this review.

findings.title: Group-commit re-run feeds mutated meta to BeforePublish
findings.validation: TestBeforePublishReplayStartsWithOriginalMetadata

findings.title: removeStaleTempDirs deletes another same-ID server's temp dirs
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Temporary cleanup identifies instances by persisted server ID. Concurrent same-ID process cleanup needs a process/filesystem test.

findings.title: /servers.json/ bypasses the Host check
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Preset-file regex does not cover a trailing slash. Need prove the router serves the same file through that alternate path.

findings.title: UI-server DNS lookups cannot be cancelled
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: DNS uses callback dns.lookup without a cancellation API. Resource retention after cancellation requires a stalled-resolver test.

findings.title: s3:PutObject* in templates grants ACL and retention changes
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Read/write policy template includes s3:PutObject*, covering ACL and lock actions. This is a template privilege-scope decision, not evidence of IAM evaluation failure.

findings.title: Session-only secret follows a moved preset in other tabs
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Cross-tab reload reattaches session secrets by connection ID. Endpoint-binding regression and migration are needed.

findings.title: Disconnect does not forget session secrets in other tabs
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Disconnect calls clearCredentials; cross-tab invalidation needs a two-tab test before claiming persistence or closure.

findings.title: UI-server scans have no overall deadline
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Scan endpoint passes client-abort signal without an overall scan deadline. Establish lower-level bounds and stalled-network behavior.

findings.title: Full sync races config writes
findings.validation: TestFullSyncDoesNotOverwriteNewerConfig

findings.title: Lifecycle noncurrent age uses the successor's imported timestamp
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Lifecycle uses successor LastModified as noncurrent-since; imports preserve old modification times. Need import-order/lifecycle regression and stored noncurrent-time design.

findings.title: Backends allow Suspended versioning on lock buckets
findings.validation: conformance Buckets/ObjectLockRequiresVersioning

findings.title: Compressibility leaks to the remote
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Compression changes stored lengths, revealing compressibility. This is an encryption leakage/tradeoff question; padding policy and threat model are unresolved.

findings.title: Documented keygen > gos3.env is world-readable
findings.validation: source review: umask 077 before creating the redirected file

findings.title: "Release PR source" gate runs on pull_request
findings.validation: TestReleaseSourceGateUsesBaseWorkflow

findings.title: Release publishes a pre-existing foreign draft as-is
findings.validation: TestReleaseNeverPublishesAnExistingDraft

findings.title: Socket/GitGuardian required checks have no integration_id
findings.validation: TestSecurityChecksBoundToPublisher; app IDs verified from PR #64 check runs

findings.title: GHCR tags can be re-pushed; manifests pull by tag
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Kustomize uses a version tag and documents optional digest pinning. A verified published digest or required deployment input is still needed; no digest was invented.

findings.title: Copy jobs and restores choose a backing with no backing grant
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Job and restore authorization checks bucket grants while creation selects a backing. Backing-scoped authorization needs tests before submission, dry-run and resume.

findings.title: Location.Check accepts UNC paths (NTLM leak)
findings.validation: TestLocationCheck

findings.title: Web UI restic snippet runs no Location.Check
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: resticSnippet emits repository and options without the CLI Location.Check allowlist. Clipboard execution against a malicious server still needs a UI regression and safe blocked-snippet behavior.

findings.title: Foreign writers set lock state through gos3-meta
findings.validation: TestForeignExtensionCannotSetObjectLock

findings.title: In-flight DeleteObjects uses a stale lock snapshot
findings.validation: TestBulkDeleteDoesNotUseStaleBucketLockFlag

findings.title: Reconcile promotes an unsynced replica
findings.validation: TestReconcileRefusesUnsyncedPrimaryReplacement

findings.title: Bodyless 503 on an anonymous denied read marks the backing down
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Generic remote 5xx maps to backing unavailable. The claimed anonymous-denial path needs a remote-service regression to distinguish object denial from backing failure.

findings.title: Prefix restore copies the policy unscoped
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Snapshot restore rewrites bucket names but copies policy without prefix restriction. Prefix restore must skip policy or reuse a proven narrowing transform.

findings.title: DeleteBucket deletes the primary before persisting
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Primary DeleteBucket precedes placement persistence. The new no-unsynced-promotion rule mitigates one recovery hazard but is not a durable deletion-intent fix.

findings.title: K8s example secret not on the deny list
findings.validation: TestDemoCredentialsRefused

findings.title: iam.json has no private ACL on Windows
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: IAM persistence uses temp-file permissions; Windows ACL parity needs an inherited-ACL test. No Windows DACL fix is claimed.

findings.title: NetworkPolicy admits whole namespaces
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: NetworkPolicy grants ingress to whole named namespaces. This is a deployment trust-scope choice; pod selectors require deployment-specific labels.

findings.title: Unknown-Host anonymous requests enumerate bucket names
findings.validation: TestUnknownHostPostDoesNotRevealBucket

findings.title: Native delimiter listing does one remote LIST per prefix
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Generic delimiter listing restarts walks for common prefixes. Remote request amplification needs a request-count test and delimiter-aware listing design.

findings.title: Native noncurrent expiry is quadratic
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Each native expiry check walks preceding versions. Repeated expiry can be quadratic; workload test and streaming pruning design remain.

findings.title: Markdown table padding amplification
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Markdown table rows pad to header width. Need a bounded-output regression and cell/output budget.

findings.title: ListMultipartUploads drops uploads when the marker is gone
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: A vanished upload marker falls back to UploadID ordering even though uploads use initiation order. Deleted-marker pagination test pending.

findings.title: ListObjectVersions skips versions after a deleted marker
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Index walk uses a marker position only when the version still exists. Deleted-marker semantics and fs/index parity require regressions.

findings.title: Lossy Sid replaces another user's grant
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: sidSuffix strips all non-alphanumeric characters. Collision behavior in grant replacement needs a regression and collision-free encoding migration.

findings.title: ui-test can swap the ui-embed artifact
findings.validation: TestEmbeddedArtifactBoundToProducer

findings.title: Restic restores are outside the one-writer rule
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Active copy-job reservations include copy and mirror kinds only. Restore coordination remains open with J-11/J-16.

findings.title: Windows snapshot --time in ambiguous local time
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Windows timeArg deliberately uses system local time without an offset. Ambiguous DST-hour interpretation needs a Windows/restic integration test.

findings.title: Claims stay keyed to the endpoint used at Open after a reconfigure
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Connection reconfiguration changes the live connection; claims are endpoint-keyed. Rebinding/releasing claims atomically needs a dedicated test.

findings.title: config print leaves out backings.json
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: config print overlays settings.json in the inspected path. backings.json parity with server loading needs a CLI regression.

findings.title: Allow+NotAction silently grants admin actions
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: NotAction complements actions across namespaces with Resource=*. Verify/document whether broad admin access is intended before changing existing policies.

findings.title: Re-created name inherits aux snapshots
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Snapshot fallback state is keyed by bucket name. Incarnation binding is still needed; new replica safeguards do not fix this.

findings.title: Failed dir fsync desyncs iam.json from memory
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: IAM atomic writer can return a directory-sync failure after rename. Memory/disk consistency and indeterminate commit handling need injected fsync tests.

findings.title: Restore-created bucket gets no owner or region
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Restore CreateBucketOptions in the inspected path sets backing/import/lock but omits owner and region. Delegated ownership behavior needs an API regression.

findings.title: /_gos3/info lists every interface address
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Info publishes advertised interface URLs. Disclosure depends on publicInfo and endpoint selection; assess configuration before changing discovery behavior.

findings.title: Root secret printed to a TTY stderr
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Generated root secrets are deliberately displayed only to a TTY. This is an explicit bootstrap-policy risk, not an accidental log leak established here.

findings.title: security.md claims pnpm audit runs
findings.validation: source review: no pnpm audit invocation in .github workflows; documentation corrected

findings.title: Option values unquoted in the env comment
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Option hints are comments sanitized by commentSafe but values are not shell-quoted. Copy/paste accuracy fix remains; no active comment injection demonstrated.

findings.title: 403 on versioning probe treated as absent
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: A denied versioning probe disables that capability and leaves unversioned state, intentionally supporting object-only credentials. Unknown-state modeling needs a compatibility decision.

findings.title: BackingID joined into the cache path
findings.validation: TestMarkerRejectsPathBackingID

findings.title: --secret-key puts a secret on argv
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: The CLI accepts secret-key on argv and already supports environment variables. Reducing process-list exposure is an interface/documentation decision.

findings.title: Stage keeps plaintext after a crash
findings.validation: source-triage-only; no independent exploit reproduction claimed
findings.assessment: Snapshot staging writes a plaintext tree and records its path. Crash recovery/secure storage policy needs a process-crash test.

additional_findings.title: Unexpected object metadata lookup failures bypass tag-based Deny on writes
additional_findings.validation: TestAuthorizationLookupFailureCannotHideDenyTags; fails on audited baseline and passes with fail-closed lookup handling

additional_findings.title: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts nested DigestAlgorithm elements
additional_findings.assessment: GitHub Dependabot alert #1 confirmed in pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm why. Advisory has no first_patched_version as of this review. Reachability of vulnerable signature verification from gos3 input is not demonstrated; presence of a runtime-classified dependency is not proof of an exposed gos3 route.

additional_findings.title: braces stack exhaustion from deeply nested patterns
additional_findings.assessment: GitHub Dependabot alert #2 confirmed in pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm why. Advisory has no first_patched_version as of this review. Need verify whether untrusted users can reach these build/tooling pattern parsers; no unsupported dependency version was invented or installed.
